# Rate Limits and Message Size Constraints

Covers Discord API rate limits and message/embed/file size constraints. See
[citations.md](../citations.md) for full source details.

## REST API Rate Limits

### Global Rate Limit

| Property | Value | Source |
|----------|-------|--------|
| Limit | 50 requests per second per bot | [4] |
| Scope | Per bot token (per IP if unauthenticated) | [4] |
| Interaction endpoints | **Exempt** from global cap | [4] |
| Independence | Global and per-route limits are independent | [4] |

### Per-Route Rate Limits

Per-route limits are applied individually to specific endpoints with HTTP
methods. Routes share buckets identified via `X-RateLimit-Bucket` header,
calculated using top-level resources: `channel_id`, `guild_id`, `webhook_id`,
or `webhook_id + webhook_token`. [4]

Discord does not publish a complete list of per-route limits — they are
communicated only via response headers. [4]

### Rate Limit Response Headers

| Header | Meaning | Source |
|--------|---------|--------|
| `X-RateLimit-Limit` | Total requests allowed in window | [4] |
| `X-RateLimit-Remaining` | Requests available before reset | [4] |
| `X-RateLimit-Reset` | Unix epoch timestamp of reset | [4] |
| `X-RateLimit-Reset-After` | Seconds until reset (decimal) | [4] |
| `X-RateLimit-Bucket` | Unique rate limit bucket ID | [4] |
| `X-RateLimit-Global` | Present if global limit exceeded | [4] |
| `X-RateLimit-Scope` | `user`, `global`, or `shared` | [4] |

### HTTP 429 Response

Returns JSON body: [4]

| Field | Type | Purpose |
|-------|------|---------|
| `message` | string | Rate limit notification |
| `retry_after` | float | Seconds to wait before retry |
| `global` | boolean | Whether global limit was hit |
| `code` | integer? | Optional error code |

### Cloudflare Ban

10,000 invalid requests per 10 minutes triggers temporary IP restriction. [4]

Invalid requests are defined as 401, 403, or 429 responses. 429s with
`X-RateLimit-Scope: shared` do not count against this threshold. [4]

## Gateway Rate Limits

| Property | Value | Source |
|----------|-------|--------|
| Event send rate | 120 events per 60 seconds per connection | [1] |
| Average | ~2 events/second (calculated from 120/60) | [1] |
| Exceed penalty | Immediate disconnection | [1] |
| Repeat penalty | API access revoked | [1] |
| Identify limit | 1000 per 24 hours (global, all shards) | [1] |
| Identify concurrency | `max_concurrency` per 5 seconds (default 1) | [1] |
| Max payload size | 4096 bytes | [1] |

## Webhook Rate Limits

| Property | Value | Source |
|----------|-------|--------|
| Execute rate | 5 requests per 2 seconds per webhook | [11] |
| Reliability | Sporadic 429s even within stated limits | [11] |
| Retries | No automatic retries or delivery guarantees | [11] |

Note: The webhook rate limit comes from the Hookdeck guide [11], not official
Discord documentation.

## Message Size Constraints

### Content

| Constraint | Limit | Source |
|-----------|-------|--------|
| Message content | 2000 characters | [8] |
| Webhook username | 80 characters | [12] |

### Embed Limits

| Field | Limit | Source |
|-------|-------|--------|
| Title | 256 characters | [8] |
| Description | 4096 characters | [8] |
| Author name | 256 characters | [8] |
| Footer text | 2048 characters | [8] |
| Field name | 256 characters each | [8] |
| Field value | 1024 characters each | [8] |
| Fields per embed | 25 | [8] |
| Embeds per message | 10 | [8] |
| **Combined total** | **6000 characters** | [8] |

The combined total counts characters across: title, description, field.name,
field.value, footer.text, and author.name for **all embeds** in a message. [8]

The birdie0 community guide confirms all official limits match. [12]

### File Attachments

| Constraint | Limit | Source |
|-----------|-------|--------|
| Files per webhook message | 10 | [12] |

Note: Per-file upload size limits (commonly cited as 25 MB default, 50 MB
Nitro Basic, 500 MB Nitro) were not confirmed from fetched sources. The
support.discord.com File Attachments FAQ returned 403.

## Interaction-Specific Constraints

| Constraint | Value | Source |
|-----------|-------|--------|
| Initial response deadline | 3 seconds | [2] |
| Interaction token validity | 15 minutes | [2] |
| Interaction rate limits | Exempt from 50/s global cap | [4] |

## Practical Implications for Personal Automation

For a single-server personal bot, the rate limits are generous:
- 50 REST requests/second is far above typical personal bot usage
- 120 gateway events/60 seconds is rarely a concern for a single-server bot
- The 3-second interaction response deadline is the most operationally relevant
  constraint — long-running operations must use deferred responses [2]

The 2000-character message limit is the most commonly encountered constraint
in practice. For longer content, use multiple messages or embed descriptions
(up to 4096 characters). [8]

## Gaps and Limitations

- Per-route specific limits (e.g., messages per channel per second) are not
  published by Discord [4]
- File upload size limits per tier were not confirmed (source returned 403)
- Whether the 6000-character embed total applies per-message or
  per-interaction-response was not explicitly stated, though context implies
  per-message [8]
